name: Eyeroc Manager
description: Controls the spawning and movement of the four Eyerocs.

fields.name: Movement Mode
fields.description: Determines the orientation of the four Eyerocs, which always move in a line.

0.name: Horizontal
0.description: The four Eyerocs form a horizontal line.

1.name: Vertical
1.description: The four Eyerocs form a vertical line.

2.name: Random
2.description: A random movement mode is selected.

fields.name: Formation Direction
fields.description: Determines the starting side of the four Eyerocs.

0.name: Left
0.description: The four Eyerocs start at the left edge.

1.name: Right
1.description: The four Eyerocs start at the right edge.

fields.name: Flight Pattern
fields.description: Determines the flight pattern of the Eyerocs.

0.name: Circular
0.description: The Eyerocs start at the top and fly in a circular path.

1.name: Horizontal
1.description: The Eyerocs start at the bottom and fly horizontally across the screen.

fields.name: Trigger Variable
fields.description: Room variable used to trigger the Eyeroc Manager.
